trust_decision.summary: A TLS 1.2 server decides whether to answer the client's encrypt_then_mac request (and keep ETM on) in DoClientHello. The decision must key off the negotiated suite's cipher_type, and must be taken only after the specs are populated (resumption succeeded or MatchSuite ran).

landing_point.why: The ETM respond/clear block on the server resumption path in DoClientHello, the only place where a failed resumption interacts with the ETM decision.

fix_sites.entry_point: wolfSSL_accept / wolfSSL_negotiate (TLS 1.2 or DTLS 1.2 server processing a ClientHello)
fix_sites.module_kind: core handshake state machine (already patched at pinned commit; the fix diff has no source hunks)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the session-resumption ETM-downgrade gap below: the session cache does not store ETM state, so a solver could argue that RFC 7366 resumption consistency is a separate feature from the advisory's failed-resumption ordering bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: ETM must still be cleared when the negotiated suite is stream or AEAD, and when the version is TLS 1.3. Forcing encThenMac=1 on every resumption path would break those suites.

O6_input_shapes: ClientHello with a 32-byte session ID that misses the server cache (resumption fails, then a full handshake runs)
ClientHello resuming successfully with a CBC suite

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A resumed session does not record whether ETM was in use (the session has no ETM field, unlike the haveEMS check), so a resumption that omits ETM is not detected as a downgrade.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: This is a different RFC 7366 property from the published bug (decision ordering), and a design addition rather than a regression.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 700 lines from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A HAVE_SECRET_CALLBACK resumption branch that runs the ETM decision before MatchSuite populates specs.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This branch calls MatchSuite inside HandleTlsResumption, so a maintainer could reorder the ETM decision relative to it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The SetCipherSpecs-time ETM clear running before cipher_type is set on another path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same zero-initialised cipher_type ordering hazard in a lower-level specs setter.

O9_family: crypto misuse / protocol downgrade (CWE-757: ETM silently negotiated down to MAC-then-Encrypt)

O10_build.toolchain: autotools or CMake with gcc/clang (./configure --enable-encrypt-then-mac default on)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/api/test_tls.c:997-1084 (test_tls12_etm_failed_resumption, run via tests/unit.test with memio)

j.j_sites_touched: none in fix diff (empty merge commit); equivalent fix already at src/internal.c
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop the cipher_type==block condition on the resumption path, which keeps ETM on for stream/AEAD suites.

out_of_scope_notes: src/internal.c:38662-38670: the '#endif' before 'else if (session->haveEMS ...)' means the EMS mismatch check is skipped whenever the expiry check is compiled in and the session is expired (benign there, since resuming is already cleared). This is an EMS matter, not ETM.
